Germany Investigates Suspected Power Grid Sabotage Amidst Energy Concerns

German authorities are investigating a second incident of suspected sabotage targeting the country's power grid. Police suspect foul play after another device was found, raising fears of hybrid warfare. This comes as Germany's gas storage facilities are only 53% full, significantly below levels seen in previous years, sparking concerns about a potential energy crisis. The economics of gas storage have reportedly shifted, leading to new dependencies, particularly on American liquefied natural gas (LNG).
